note: NO RULING IS MADE HERE. Every founder_decision field is null and stays null until a human fills it. This packet exists because the market's boundary was, in seven places, decided by whether a municipality string happened to appear in a corridor's included_cities list -- which is a data-entry fact, not a geography ruling. 9 properties sit behind these seven names: 8 currently excluded and 1 already admitted. Under the market's declared MARKET_GEOGRAPHY basis a candidate in one of these municipalities whose coordinates fall inside the bounds is BORDERLINE and is held MARKET_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED for review -- it is not silently dropped, and it is not silently admitted either. Three further municipalities were surfaced by the shadow recensus and appended: Farmington Hill (an OSM spelling variant of the registered Farmington Hills), Farmington, and Plymouth Township. Together the ten names account for all 24 MARKET_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED candidates the shadow run produced.

market_bounds_unchanged_by_this_order._disclosure: A loose enclosing box spanning the Detroit metro core, Oakland County suburbs, DTW airport, and the Ann Arbor / Washtenaw core, not an authoritative MSA boundary. Two distinct travel cores (Detroit and Ann Arbor) share this one box.

items.question_for_the_founder: Allen Park is the ONE municipality this market currently answers both ways. Best Western Greenfield Inn is IN the census, admitted to the dearborn corridor by explicit_hotel_ids -- the market's only explicit assignment. Comfort Inn & Suites Allen Park - Dearborn was boundary_excluded for being in the same city. Allen Park appears in no corridor's included_cities and in no included_municipalities entry, so under MARKET_GEOGRAPHY a fresh Allen Park candidate is BORDERLINE and held UNRESOLVED.

rows_currently_excluded_on_this_municipa.ledger_note: PTF-DETROIT-ANN-ARBOR-CENSUS-COMPLETENESS-003: Same city as the already-known Best Western Greenfield Inn boundary flag from Phase 1 (Allen Park, not Dearborn).

items.what_admitting_would_mean: Add 'Allen Park' to included_municipalities in scripts/pettripfinder/discovery/config/detroit_ann_arbor_mi.json and to the included_cities of detroit-ann-arbor-mi__dearborn. Every affected row above becomes eligible for the census on its own geography; none is admitted automatically -- each still has to clear identity and routing.
items.what_excluding_would_mean: Record an explicit out-of-market ruling naming 'Allen Park', so that the next recensus reports these rows as a BOUNDARY DECISION rather than re-surfacing them as UNRESOLVED every pass. Silence is what produced the current ambiguity.
items.preserve: PRESERVE Best Western Greenfield Inn's existing history whichever way this is ruled. It is a committed IDENTITY_CONFIRMED census row, it holds ROUTING_CONFIRMED route detroit-ann-arbor-mi:best-western-greenfield-inn, and it is the market's only assignment_basis=explicit row. A ruling that ADMITS Allen Park should convert it from an explicit override to an ordinary city assignment WITHOUT changing its identity_key, its route or its evidence. A ruling that EXCLUDES Allen Park must SUPERSEDE this row with an explicit out-of-market ruling that names it -- it may never be dropped silently, and its route and history stay on the record.
